lawyer:
Muhammad Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-record ------ For the Petitioner 
Syed Mahbubar Rahman, Advocate-on-record ------ For the Respondents
parties:
Mahmuda Haq ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Abdul Mannan Miah and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 3. Title Suit No. 26 of 1992 was filed averring, that the land in suit was recorded in the R.S. Khatian in the name of Makim Bepari and others, that by a partition deed dated August 13, 1948 the land of A.S. khatian was partitioned among the co-sharers, that Makim Bepari while owning and possessing the land in suit died leaving   his brother Munsur Bepari as the sole heir, that the plaintiffs purchased the land in suit and the other land on October 30, 1973, that plaintiffs in connection with their service were staying at different places and because of that they entrusted management of the land to Majid Mia, that the defendant Nos. 1-27 to grab the land in suit filed Title Suit No. 42 of 1986, that inspite of non-service of summons Mazid Mia informed plaintiff No.1 about the filing   of the suit and he entrusted Mazid Mia for taking steps in the suit, that Mazid Mia being gained over by the defendant Nos.1-27   did not take steps in the suit and that finally defendant Nos. 1-27 upon practicing fraud on the Court obtained ex-parte decree on July 18, 1988 in preliminary form and the said decree was made final on August 30, 1989 and that on the basis of the fraudulent decree the defendant Nos. 1-27 started Title Execution Case No.10 of 1989 and no notice of Title execution case was served on the plaintiffs, that plaintiffs entrusted management of the land in suit to Majid Mia and that the plaintiffs upon making construction let out the premises in suit to different tenants, that in 1992 plaintiff No.1 after retiring from the service went to his village home and thereafter went to the Court for ascertaining position of the suit and from an information slip obtained through the clerk of an Advocate, the plaintiff No. 1 came to know about the decree dated July 18, 1988 and August 30, 1989 and that also delivery of possession of the partitioned land in pursuant to the order passed in Title Execution Case No.10 of 1989.
